records.description_rewritten: Düsseldorf Südpark is a large, family-oriented 70-hectare municipal park comprising Volksgarten, In den Gärten and Vor dem Deich. The original gay-directory listing alleges occasional cruising around theme gardens and secluded paths, but its latest dated forum comments are from May–June 2025, just outside this research cycle's 12-month cutoff. Both were ordinary visits, not confirmed encounters; a May visitor explicitly found no interest. This is a historic candidate, not verified current cruising.

supplementary_evidence.finding: City describes three distinct public sections, playgrounds, gardens, a lake, petting zoo and 70 ha.

historical_or_older_posts.finding: Visitor enjoyed benches and quiet evening areas but describes no cruising.
Visited for an hour, nothing happened.

records.access_information: Public park used by families and children. Source's multi-section descriptions are not precise cruising point; no authorisation for sexual activity.
duplicate_and_safety_flags: Old forum activity only; last dated June 2025.
Do not conflate the entire Volksgarten with a small proposed cruise subarea.

records.description_rewritten: Himmelgeist is a broad protected Rhine bend with some historic naturist recreation near river kilometre 727. A 4 July 2026 first-person forum visitor reported searching the shore but found no nude bathers, while a 26 May entry merely proposed visiting. Older users dispute the map's kilometre placement and describe other locations on the Neuss side (km 731–732) as separate. Düsseldorf's 2026 regulations prohibit swimming in the entire city Rhine section; nature reserve and deich project protections apply.

supplementary_evidence.finding: Düsseldorf's Rhine bathing ban in force through 31 Dec 2026.
Municipal nature reserve and marked public trails; natural/floodplain protections.
Nov–Dec 2026 public planning procedure for Rhine flood protection; proposals do not establish construction closures now.

recent_dated_reports.finding: Visited the prior Sunday, found no nude sunbathers; did not report cruising.

historical_or_older_posts.finding: Claims the actual km727 is farther south than page pin; not independently located.

records.access_information: Public allowed marked trails, nature reserve zoning and no swimming/wading deeper than ankle-level under Düsseldorf's river ban; do not suggest off-path reserve entry.
duplicate_and_safety_flags: NSG Himmelgeister Rheinbogen and river bathing prohibition.
Km 727 mapped location contested; no exact GPS.
Neuss-side km 731–732 is separate and should not be automatically merged.

records.description_rewritten: Hofgarten is a public central Düsseldorf garden; the directory concerns paths around Inselstraße and nearby Ratinger Tor, not every part of the garden. A first-person post on 15 December 2025 says the writer visited five times since November and had three consensual encounters; this is within the current twelve-month window, but remains unverified self-report. A June 2025 writer was present with no contacts. Neither post justifies fixed peak times or a guarantee of current activity.

supplementary_evidence.finding: Original source labels Hofgarten near Inselstraße.

recent_dated_reports.finding: Forum user reports five visits since Nov and three contacts; not independently corroborated.

historical_or_older_posts.finding: Visitor says present, many passersby, no matching contact.

records.access_information: Public shared garden with passersby; privacy and consent important. No sanctioned sexual-use zone or reliable official night hours recorded.
duplicate_and_safety_flags: 2025-12-15 falls within cutoff; self-report, not independent verification.
Source points to Inselstraße path rather than the entire park.

records.description_rewritten: A historic cruising-directory entry refers to public toilets near Burgplatz 3 in Düsseldorf Altstadt. Düsseldorf's current municipal facilities list distinguishes a Burgplatz public urinal open 24 hours from a separately scheduled, enclosed toilet at Burgplatz 2. The original forum says the area reopened in April 2023 after earlier work, while the most recent post (18 April 2025) only asks about opening hours; neither proves cruising in 2026. Exact match between the source's old 'Klappe' and today's facilities remains unconfirmed.

supplementary_evidence.finding: Burgplatz urinal 24/7; Burgplatz 2 full WC separate daytime/evening hours; not proof cruising.

historical_or_older_posts.finding: Asks current toilet hours and crowd.
Forum user says open again; not independently current.

records.access_information: City urinal at Burgplatz listed 24h, separately Burgplatz 2 WC with different scheduled hours; both managed public sanitation, not sex venues. Do not conflate their addresses or invite disruptive use.
duplicate_and_safety_flags: Official site has at least two nearby toilets with different schedules.
2023 reopening anecdote not current cruising evidence.

There are no verified 2026 cruising visitors in this source.
